summary: Official Nam Định provincial land-registration and land/environment custodians were evidenced, but no anonymous city-bounded parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. This is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
queryOutcomes: English and Vietnamese discovery queries are recorded in city-3207-nam-nh.json. Results identified official provincial and national procedure/documentation pages, not an open parcel service.
requestOutcomes: Nam Định provincial portal direct GET failed TLS certificate-chain verification and was not bypassed; bandovn.vn timed out in a bounded anonymous GET; a non-government GIS.vn API page returned 200 but was not treated as a registry source and no parcel query was made; an official provincial decision was available through first-party search/open and documented the land-registration office mandate.
scopeLimits: No city boundary or complete Nam Định cadastral coverage was established.
No exact-point hit/miss was used as an absence claim.
No parcel geometry, native ID or source-specific attributes were retained.
General national agency prose and a non-government API advertisement are not treated as proof of a Nam Định open registry adapter.
No login, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe owner/address/titleholder field, or TLS-disable operation was used.
nativeIdentityPolicy: No native parcel identity was observed; no synthetic identity was created. If a future public response is found, retain only one stable native identity in GeoJSON properties and document native field mapping and composite-key provenance here.
serialReviewerQualification: not qualified; independent serial review still required
uncertainty: Official local custody is evidenced, but anonymous map/API access, city scope, schema, CRS and parcel geometry remain unknown. TLS failure and timeout are transport/access outcomes only.
